_comment: BG PLACES (2026-10-16): the vols 1-4 scenes (branch claude/vol1-4-source-text) name
flat pictures — assets/backgrounds/<stem>.jpg — that were never made. GameEngine._do_bg looks the
stem up here and plays the 3D set instead, so those scenes render without editing their JSON.
fit: exact (the place) · reuse (an existing set that is this kind of place) · standin (the nearest
set until its 'build' locale exists) · 2d (stays a picture; to: null until it is painted).
When a build group's locale lands, point its stems at the new presets and change fit to exact.
by_scene (2026-10-17): {scene_id: '3d:<preset>'} picks a different view of the same place for one scene (the sleep lab at work vs. at night).
